Name: Always Show (Health and Stamina) Bar Values
Author: Saah
Description:
[size=5]Description
[/size]This is a simple mod inspired by Numerical Health. All it does is add a small box at the position of your choosing with the numerical values of your health and stamina/energy bar. You can configure it through Generic Mod Config Menu; it has preset positions and also a "Custom" option for you to place the box anywhere you want. You can also change the background, the text colors, and remove the text shadow if you want.

[size=5]Requirements
[/size][list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ 4.0+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[/list]
[size=5]Installation
[/size][list]
[*]To install this mod, follow the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Getting Started[/url]﻿ guide, it explains better than I ever could.
[*]To configure it, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. X and Y only work when Custom is selected.
[*]To uninstall it, simply delete this mod's folder. It doesn't touch your saves and is safe to remove at any time.
[/list]
[size=5]Known Issues[/size][list]
[*]Presets are optimized for big screens. If your screen is smaller (or you play on windowed mode), I recommend using the Custom option.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*]Fully compatible with any UI recoloring/redesigning mods
[*]I can't think of anything that would render this incompatible with another mod
[/list]
[size=5]Feedback
[/size][list]
[*]Bug reports go in the Bugs tab, not the Posts tab! Please include a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]﻿ with any report.
[*]Suggestions, requests and questions go in the Posts tab
[*]I'm not super happy with my presets, so I'm open to feedback on them. I won't add a Top Right preset.
[/list][size=5]Notes
[/size][list]
[*]Source code released under [url=https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/]MPL[/url] on [url=https://github.com/sarahvloos/StardewMods/tree/main/AlwaysShowBarValues]GitHub[/url]﻿
[*]This isn't translation-ready, I can do that if someone requests it.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added option to completely disable a box, fixed health and stamina icons being swapped (oops!), attempted to fix box showing up during events. Please let me know if you ever see your stamina bar but not the box with its value!
